buyer: Architecture practices and developers needing imagery
v1: A set of images for one scheme
verdict: Her design eye is real, but this is a crowded, price-collapsing commodity market.

why.demand: Visualisation is definitely paid for today, by many providers.
why.fmf: Her design judgement is genuine, though she is not a specialist visualiser.
why.defensibility: Generative image tools have collapsed the barrier to entry entirely.
why.leverage: Faster with AI but still per-project work.
why.tailwind: Actively adverse - AI is destroying pricing in exactly this category.
why.ceiling: £3k x 35 schemes = £105k in a market where prices are falling monthly.

ceiling_arithmetic: £3k x 35 schemes = £105k, against offshore studios and AI tools driving per-scheme prices toward hundreds. Realistic: £25-40k and declining.
carries: Genuine visual judgement and a warm channel.
kills: The category is being commoditised by the same technology that would let her enter it.
test: Quote three practices for a visual set.
test_fail: They quote an offshore studio at a fifth of the price - the likely answer.
